5.. INTRODUCTION OF STEPHAN TUCKER, GENERAL MANAGER OF WATER REPLENISHMENT DISTRICT Mayor Davis-Holmes introduced Stephan Tucker, General Manager of Water Replenishment District who introduced Director Robles Dewitt who recognized Stephan Tucker as the new member of the team.
Tucker gave a brief history of his background; 
Tucker gave an overview of the Water Replenishment District and projects they are working on.

Mayor requested Mr. Tucker to come back and give quarterly updates.

Dear - congratulates Tucker on his appointment
Hicks - welcome home
Hilton - congratulation


10.. LOCAL PROJECT UPDATE PRESENTATION FROM RUSS VAKHARIA, SUPERVISING ENGINEER OF CONSTRUCTION MANAGEMENT FROM THE SANITATION DISTRICTS OF LOS ANGELES COUNTY  Mayor Davis-Holmes recognized Sharon Lander, City Manager who introduced Russ Vakharia, Supervising Engineer of Construction Management from the Sanitation Districts of Los Angeles County who shared a PowerPoint to the Council.

Russ - gave a detailed overview of a new tunnel running from the Joint Water Pollution Control Plant to the beach.

Dear - thanked Russ for the presentation; how many tons of dirt and rock will by excavating from the shaft, Russ - will get back with an answer;

Dear - is the City requiring a bond to be placed since the dirt will be hauled on city streets.

Hicks - thanked Russ for the presentation, also no residents will be feeling any vibration. Russ trucks will be traveling on streets but most of the work is heading opposite of residents.
Hicks - will the machine run across any faultlines that may cause an earthquake? No

Dear - is there a number the public can cll


6.. INTRODUCTION OF DIANA MEDEL, DIRECTOR OF STRATEGIC PARTNERSHIPS OF THE BOYS & GIRLS CLUBS OF CARSON Mayor Davis-Holmes introduced Diana Medel, Director of Strategic Partnerships of the Boys & Girls Clubs of Carson.
Ms. Medel, gave a brief overview of her background. Wants to remind the community of the mission of Boys & Girls Club in to provide a safe place for the kids.
Back to school supply drive were backpacks can be dropped off at the Doubletree Hotel.

Hilton - welcomes Ms. Medel back to Carson; Cities have partnered along with the Boys & Girls Club.

Dear - welcomes Ms. Medel on her position and work she is doing in the City 

Hicks - wanted to reiterate an agreement with the Boys & Girls Club

27.. COVID-19 UPDATE (CITY COUNCIL) City Mgr - recognized Raymond Cheung who gave a PowerPoint presentation when the City Council reopens, on the seating arrangements for the Council, Staff and general public.

Hicks - proposing another vaccination center in Carson, and lets do it quickly.

Mayor would like Cheung to send the dates for the vaccination in the City of Carson

Hicks - can the Disaster Council give some sort of incentive for the residents to come get vaccinated.

Mayor - how to re-invent how to get the people to come out and get vaccinated.

Kennedy - gave the price for barriers in the audience will cost around $4,000.00

Dear - follow the science and experts direction, and when safe we should move forward

Mayor - would like to recommend that we move forward with staff making the purchase and being ready when we open.

Hicks - biggest concern is the 6 ft distance
Where are we at with our air conditioning system.
Eliza Jane - the HVAC system is nearly completed
Sharon - those who go into chamber or community center be vaccinated or provide proof of a covid19 test;
also asking staff to voluntary report if they have been vaccinated.

4.. REPORT FROM CAPTAIN JONES OF CARSON SHERIFF'S STATION Capt. Jones - spoke on the virtual meeting on last Thursday and thanked the residents for their input;
Block captain meeting was held on last week along with Carson Public Safety;
Comm. Relation kicked off a book drive for school supplies at Doubletree;
Directive patrol over the last few weeks to help prevent trucks idling in the street;
Vehicle, foot pursuit was conducted and captured a murder suspect;
Deputies continue to be in the community and being active as a deterrent to crime;
Tomorrow will be Community Night Out moving around from various City Parks.

Dear: where do they want the council members to be meet at the station at 4pm and ride a trolley to various parks

HIlton: we are starting to have a problem with the homeless and mentally ill in the city; recommends adopting an Ordinance that if a station bring someone to Harbor General that upon their release they should be released to the station that dropped them off. Capt. Jones has been in discussion with LAPD and other agency to try and rectify this problem.
HIlton: write a letter to our County Supv. to try and rectify this problem
Capt. Jones thanked the community for being involved in the community
Mayor want to meet with CM and Hilton to sit down and talk about the legislation LA just passed about homeless sleeeping on city streets.
Hicks, thanked Capt. Jones for being informative.
